x: Herbert, Bruce, in 7th place, our "D" team of—Ken Stimpson, Bolam, Stace, Len Bishop, were 16th and our "E" team—R. Mitchell, Cuff, Tween, Porter, 22nd out of the 30 clubs that closed in.

Porter is doing very well with the Hammer, and we are expecting something very good from him before the end of the season. Van Sukavachana is Pole Vaulting very well and should encourage more Club members to compete against him, when we hope to see an improvement in this branch of our Field Events.

Len Bishop also coming into the team as a reserve, had the unenviable task of coping with Douglas of the Beagles and Ralph Dunkley of the Poly and although he drove himself to the last ounce, he was forced to give ground to this pair and to Porter of Finchley and we were once more back to fourth.

One of the highlights of the Games was the high-jump duel between Dumas of the U.S.A. and unknown Porter of Australia - Dumas who found it too much trouble to convert metres to feet and Porter who peered at the bar before jumping.
